About the Red Hot Diabetes Riders (Pearl Harbor Path) group ride

Red Hot Diabetes Riders (Pearl Harbor Path) is a road and social group ride in Aiea, HI. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Neal S. Blaisdell Park.

An easy-paced 10 to 12 mile ride on the Pearl Harbor Historic Path, listed by HBL as a weekly beginner ride.
